capabilities: Serialize a Bases view into static Markdown
Refresh the snapshot in place using sentinel comment blocks
Format output as list, checklist, numbered list, or table
Freeze an embed by replacing the live base embed with plain Markdown
Write snapshots to a target note or section heading
disambiguation: Not a file export tool; it writes a snapshot block into a note inside the vault rather than producing files elsewhere.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10.0+ with Bases enabled; it can only add a Serializer view type, not serialize the built-in Table/Cards views. The README discloses the implementation was largely AI-assisted under the author's direction. The plugin carries the standard unreviewed-plugin notice.
intentEvidence: Requires Obsidian 1.10.0+ (the public Bases API). QueryController is opaque, so this must be a view type
problem: Bases views are dynamic and live inside .base files, so their results are invisible to the Graph, Search, Publish, exports and other tools that only read note text.

relations.evidence: Or use BRAT with pedroilidio/obsidian-bases-serializer if you want to track versions ahead of a release.

summary: Freezes an Obsidian Bases view into static Markdown inside a note, wrapped in sentinel comments so the snapshot can be refreshed in place.
